title: Pixel Runner v2: 100 Levels, Better Progression, Backend & Polish
description:
Major game overhaul:
1. BUGS: checkExitCollision doesn't call completeLevel (only death does), level completion screen missing, all skins unlocked (no progression lock), skills have undefined levelReq in data structure
2. UI: Back buttons in ALL submenus (Shop has them, Skills/Battle Pass need consistent ESC+button approach), level progress bar during gameplay
3. WORLD GEN: 100 levels (not 12), progressive difficulty (longer levels, more obstacles, new enemy types), themed biomes properly balanced
4. PROGRESSION: Lock skins behind level/coin requirements, more skills (6+), meaningful skill tree, better XP curve
5. BACKEND: User authentication backend (Supabase/Firebase), persistent progress, leaderboard
6. POLISH: Level complete celebration screen with stars, smooth transitions, sound effects hooks
